verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a cloud platform could plausibly offer user-configured background or agentic automations, but the pack documents no such feature. The Mission Control Agent and MCP server are described only as tools for investigating the environment and making supported changes, with nothing on autonomous, scheduled, or background runs. The Cluster Autoscaler, bucket lifecycle policies, and Slurm batch jobs are adjacent infrastructure behaviors or building blocks, not user-defined automations, so they earn no credit.
